description: QueryPilot text-to-SQL evaluation set. Each question has a hand-written, manually checked reference query; expected results are produced by running it on the seeded database (seed 42). `compare` lists the expected-result columns that must appear (by value, any column name) in the model's result; `ordered` says whether row order matters.

questions.question: What is our total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')

questions.question: Which five products generated the highest revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Show the customer IDs and names of the five customers who placed the most orders, with their order counts.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What was our monthly revenue over the last six months?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: Which product categories perform best by revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

questions.question: What is the average order value?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')

questions.question: Which products have never been ordered?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id)

questions.question: How many customers do we have in each country?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY country

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: What was the revenue for each payment method in 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY o.payment_method

questions.question: Which customer segment generated the most revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many units of each product category were sold in completed orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category

questions.question: Which two cities have the most customers?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: How many orders did each customer segment place in 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment
